outcome_rules: PASS requires both fresh arms complete all original work, finite losses/gradients, expected updated adapter state in memory, all cap/soft/host/no-swap invariants, complete source/runtime receipts, owned process exit and independent closure. A passed estimate alone is not a capacity PASS.

Retain any native CUDA OOM, memcg max/oom/oom_kill event, cgroup cap/host-reserve failure, missing evidence or unsupported identity as terminal failure/UNKNOWN. Do not reduce geometry, raise limits or retry under another guard.

Compare same-phase host/CUDA/cgroup/allocator axes and elapsed/IO/PSI with old failures. Different background/cache state means one new PASS is evidence of that execution, not causal proof that the predicate change alone fixed capacity.
